Curriculum

From foundational theory to hands-on practice, step by step. No prior background needed — by the end, you will be able to conduct a complete hypnosis session on your own.

01

Hypnosis and States of Consciousness

What hypnosis is — and is not; how the conscious and subconscious minds work; the characteristics of the hypnotic state and common misconceptions.

02

Hypnotic Induction Techniques

Progressive relaxation, eye fixation, breathing, and other induction methods — plus how to choose the right approach for each person.

03

Deepening and Suggestion

Techniques for deepening the hypnotic state; the language structure and principles of suggestion — guiding that is both effective and safe.

04

Subconscious Communication and Imagery Guidance

Communicate with the subconscious through imagery, metaphor, and inner dialogue — helping people find their own answers and resources.

05

Applications of Hypnosis

Guidance frameworks and session flows for common themes: relaxation, better sleep, habit change, and confidence building.

06

Hands-On Practice and Case Studies

Live demonstrations, peer practice, real case breakdowns, and Q&A — train until the techniques are truly yours to use.

Who Is This For

  • Complete Beginners— Curious about hypnosis and the subconscious; want a structured introduction rather than fragmented self-study.
  • Helping Professionals— Counselors, coaches, teachers, and trainers looking for one more powerful tool in their work.
  • Self-Growth Seekers— Those who want to relax more deeply, sleep better, and understand their inner state.
  • Aspiring Hypnotists— Those who want to learn hypnosis systematically and build a foundation for offering hypnosis services.

All classes are held online. All you need is a computer or phone with internet access, a pair of earphones, and a quiet corner.
